Name: Pyaterochka Replaces JojaMart
Author: ParabellumBlueberry
Description:
[size=4][b]EN

Description:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replacing Jojamart with the Russian grocery store Pyaterochka.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]At the moment, only the exterior! And also a winter and terminated version.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI, install Content Patcher, and then place the mod in the folder along the path:
...\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/color]

-------------------------------
